title: Sludge concentration of the return sludge from sludge volume index

symbols.definition: sludge solids concentration implied by the assumed laboratory sedimentation
volume occupied in ml by one gram of solids in the mixed liquor after settling for 30 min

applicability: Assumes that sedimentation of suspended solids in the laboratory is similar to that in the sedimentation tank; the printed text then uses Xs with 5000 mg/l for X in Equation (5.31) to obtain a recirculation ratio of 1.0.
notes: Unnumbered inline relation inside the prose; Ep377-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.
The power is printed as a superscript 6 and was confirmed at 900 dpi.
The printed prose adds a full stop after SVI ("10⁶/SVI.") which belongs to the sentence, not to the formula.
